BiblicalUsage: Chemlah is pity that moves a hand to help, and it appears only twice in the Hebrew Bible. In Genesis the angels take hold of Lot because the Lord is merciful to him, and in Isaiah the Lord redeems His people in His love and His pity, bearing them Himself.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God's pity is never cold feeling but rescue in motion, and that is how He has dealt with me too.
